projects.name: River Bend campus
projects.quote: Secured and broke ground on 592 acres at our River Bend campus in Louisiana, where initial sitework is underway.

projects.name: Vega
projects.quote: Continued construction at the 205 MW Vega site, which remains on track for energization in the second quarter of 2025, with more than 70% of ● budgeted capital expenditures incurred through March 31, 2025.
